notes.text: The linked baraita names Nahum of Galya in the case of clearing a blocked pipe on Shabbat.
[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2628&lang=en) also records Rav Yosef’s ruling in favor of Nahum’s view.
